extDescription.message: Switch between your own Roblox accounts in one click. Everything stays on your computer. Not affiliated with Roblox.

notLoggedInHint.message: Log in, then save the account here.

offlineHint.message: Check your internet connection and try again.

emptyList.message: No saved accounts yet. Save the account you're logged in with, then add another one.

pendingText.message: Log in with your other account in the tab that just opened. It will be saved automatically.

safetyNote.message: Saved only on this computer. AccountHop never asks for your password or cookie, and never sends them anywhere.

logoutTip.message: Tip: don't use “Log out” on the Roblox site for a saved account – that ends its saved session.

errExpired.message: The session of $NAME$ has expired. Choose “Log in” to renew it.

errOffline.message: Roblox can't be reached right now. Try again in a moment.

errNotLoggedIn.message: You're not logged in to Roblox.

errGeneric.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.
